crossRefs.note: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”
translations.bsb: “Tell me,” said Peter, “is this the price you and your husband got for the land?” “Yes,” she answered, “that is the price.”
translations.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
translations.asv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much. And she said, Yea, for so much.
